findings.finding: The node now has no open questions, records decided design decisions, and its design tasks are complete.
The first-pass widget lifecycle follow-up remains focused on persistent-resource owners: ChatWidget, PageBrowserWidget, CommsSummaryWidget, and ForgeLog.
Auxiliary IPC lanes remain part of the widget lifecycle contract via the PageBrowserWidget execution-lane ownership model.
One-shot helpers and largely action-driven widgets are explicitly kept out of the first migration pass unless new evidence changes priority.
The chosen direction preserves explicit per-widget ownership, keeps degradation local, and stays compatible with the async-callable/partial worker scheduling convention used in tests.
